humanization.description:
Whether this org can start optional StealthGPT humanization (D4).

Derived from the global release gate + the org's integration being
enabled + a stored key. ``reason`` is set exactly when unavailable. It
exposes no key, key hash, Vault id or provider account data, and a stale
read never authorizes a run (intake re-checks).
